System guide / Knowledge base / Var 2 · upstairs injection circulator

Var 2 · upstairs injection circulator

Routing confirmed; model provisional

Model / part
Taco 008-BC6 — provisional reading
Location
Attic plumbing wall · right-hand vertical pump

Role in the system

Draws from the main supply downstream of the attic AM30 branch. Pumps upward into the Mix 2 inlet circuit, after the combined manifold returns and their connection back to the main loop.

MC-1 output 10; neutral 9. Flash glare prevents a fully confident model reading.

Locate and identify
